name: Dragon Poker Draw
author: LoneGrayWolf2000
description: Six-card video poker inspired by Robert Asprin's Dragon Poker: bet, swap up to 4 cards and chase new hands like Full Dragon. Up to 4 jokers. X to confirm, Z for help.

descriptions.en: Six-card video poker inspired by Robert Asprin's Dragon Poker: bet, swap up to 4 cards and chase new hands like Full Dragon. Up to 4 jokers. X to confirm, Z for help.
descriptions.it: Video poker a 6 carte ispirato al Dragon Poker di Robert Asprin: punta, cambia fino a 4 carte e cerca mani nuove come il Full Dragon. Fino a 4 jolly. X conferma, Z aiuto.
